description: sprint-1-green-phase.log's own narrative text (line 89, cited as supporting evidence by CRIT-001) states gig.test.mjs contains '12 pre-existing' tests plus the GAP 2 regression test plus 3 new REQ-102 tests. Directly counting the actual test() calls in skills/economy/gig/__tests__/gig.test.mjs today shows exactly 11 tests total (FINDING 1 x2, FINDING 2 x1, the same-gig take/deliver serialization test x1, FINDING 3 x3, GAP 2 x1, PROP-102a/b/c x3 = 11), of which only 8 predate this sprint's 3 new REQ-102 additions (8 + 3 = 11) -- not '12 pre-existing + GAP 2 + 3 new' (which would total 16 and overcounts by 5, or double-counts GAP 2 within the '12'). This does not change any of the contract's binding numeric claims (48/48 total, 11 tests in gig.test.mjs, 8 tests in lock.test.mjs all independently verified by direct count against the current files), so it does not itself invalidate any CRIT item's pass condition -- but it is a factual inaccuracy in a document the contract cites as authoritative supporting evidence (CRIT-001's passThreshold: 'Evidence on file: sprint-1-green-phase.log lines 17, 96-98, 288'), and in a strict-mode gate, evidence-log narrative accuracy matters for trust in the rest of the log's uncheckable claims (e.g., the exact millisecond timings and the Tier-3-adjacent claims this review could not independently execute).

recommendation: Correct sprint-1-green-phase.log:89's prose to '8 pre-existing + the \u2605GAP 2\u2605 regression test (already counted within those 8) + 3 new REQ-102 tests = 11', matching the file's actual contents.
